## SoftBank's Masayoshi Son Allocates 67% of US Portfolio to Intel as AI Revival Bet

Son's 67% US portfolio concentration in Intel is a meaningful external validator of the Intel foundry and AI turnaround thesis; the scale of conviction from a high-profile investor raises the signal-to-noise ratio, though Son's track record with concentrated tech bets warrants calibrated weighting.

- Masayoshi Son has concentrated 67% of SoftBank's US investment portfolio in Intel, per the headline.
- The position is framed explicitly as an AI revival bet.
- The Economic Times frames this as 'the Intel wager,' signaling it is a high-conviction, concentrated call.
- No purchase price, position size in dollar terms, or timeline is stated in the headline.
